Name: Harvey Personality Mod
Author: woosh0
Description:
[size=3]Less doctor talk
More regular and marriage dialogue
New event and quests
Gives you mail and gifts
More variety to schedule and interactions with other NPCs
No more creepy Maru crushing... cause seriously how old is she?

[list]
[*][size=3]There’s an event at the graveyard when you reach 7 hearts (early morning).[/size]
[*][size=3]Sends you mail with stats-boosting food gifts.[/size]
[*][size=3]Sends you 2 quests in the mail, one of which is to find Harvey’s missing plane (new object sprite).[/size]
[*][size=3]Will actually stay at the clinic till 3pm Mon - Fri.[/size]
[*][size=3]Yoga class is now on Sundays, where you can find Harvey doing his dance aerobics with the ladies.[/size]
[*][size=3]Regularly visits Linus in the mountains to perform checkups.[/size]
[*][size=3]Harvey and Kent hang out in the Saloon every Friday. Continues during marriage.[/size]
[*][size=3]Once a year, Harvey, Gus, and Emily visit the graveyard together.[/size]
[*][size=3]Hangs out in the forest or north of clinic during the weekends.[/size]
[/list][/size][size=3]


[u]*March 18 2017 Update*
[/u]2.0 version changes:
[list]
[*][size=3]Fixed dialogue bug where Harvey would only say 'Hi.' after year 1. [/size]
[*][size=3]No more repeated dialogue. New lines added.[/size]
[*][size=3]Small cleanups to schedules for Harvey, Linus, Emily, and Gus.[/size]
[/list][/size]


[size=3]**Install Instructions**

[/size][size=3]1) Find your Stardew Content folder in your GOG or Steam account and dig around. The Content folder will have many folders and XNB files, starting with an 'Animals' folder.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]-------------------------[/size][size=3]------------------------[/size]Game folder locations[size=3]-[/size][size=3]---------------------[/size]--------------------------------------------[size=3]
[/size][size=3]WINDOWS 
[/size][size=3]GOG: C:\Program Files (x86)\GalaxyClient\Games\Stardew Valley
[/size][size=3]Steam: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]LINUX 
[/size][size=3]GOG: ~/GOG Games/Stardew Valley/game
[/size][size=3]Steam: ~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
MAC 
[/size][size=3]GOG: /Applications/Stardew Valley.app
[/size][size=3]Steam: ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]---------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]-------------------------------------------------------------------------[size=3]
[/size][size=3]
2) Backup your Content folder.[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]3) Unzip mod files. Open up Characters > Dialogue and copy all mod XNB files.[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]4) In your Stardew Content folder, open up Characters > Dialogue and replace Stardew XNB files with mod XNB files.[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]5) Repeat for all files in mod folder.[/size]
